# Downstream Analysis (R)

## Parsing VCFs directly

```{r vcf-parsing, eval=FALSE}
# Requires results/vcf/<run>.PASS.norm.vcf.gz to exist on disk
runs <- samples$run

vcf_list <- map(runs, function(run) {
  vcf_path <- file.path(vcf_dir, paste0(run, ".PASS.norm.vcf.gz"))
  read.vcfR(vcf_path, verbose = FALSE)
})
names(vcf_list) <- runs

# Example: extract fixed fields (CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, QUAL) for one sample
vcf_fix <- as_tibble(getFIX(vcf_list[["SRR2584866"]]))
kable(head(vcf_fix, 10), caption = "First 10 variant records — SRR2584866 (generation 50,000)")
```

## Variant count summary (from `variant_counts.tsv` / `pass_variant_summary.tsv`)

```{r variant-counts}
# variant_counts.tsv: sample, generation, run, raw_variants, filtered_variants
variant_counts <- tribble(
  ~sample,      ~generation, ~run,         ~raw_variants, ~filtered_variants,
  "Ara3_5000",  5000,        "SRR2589044", 13,            9,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000,       "SRR2584863", 30,            26,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000,       "SRR2584866", 817,           794
)

# pass_variant_summary.tsv: sample, generation, run, pass_variants, snps, indels, ts_tv
pass_summary <- tribble(
  ~sample,      ~generation, ~run,         ~pass_variants, ~snps, ~indels, ~ts_tv,
  "Ara3_5000",  5000,        "SRR2589044", 9,              6,     3,       2.00,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000,       "SRR2584863", 26,             20,    6,       0.33,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000,       "SRR2584866", 794,            688,   106,     10.86
)

kable(variant_counts, caption = "Raw vs. quality-filtered (PASS) variant counts per sample")
kable(pass_summary, caption = "PASS variant composition and Ts/Tv ratio per sample")
```

```{r variant-counts-plot}
pass_summary %>%
  select(sample, generation, snps, indels) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(snps, indels), names_to = "type", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(sample = fct_reorder(sample, generation)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = count, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  labs(title = "PASS SNPs vs. indels by generation",
       x = "Sample (ordered by generation)", y = "Variant count", fill = "Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r tstv-plot}
ggplot(pass_summary, aes(x = generation, y = ts_tv)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pass_summary$generation) +
  labs(title = "Transition/Transversion (Ts/Tv) ratio across generations",
       x = "Generation", y = "Ts/Tv ratio") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Mutation spectrum (from `substitution_spectrum.tsv`)

```{r mutation-spectrum}
substitution_spectrum <- tribble(
  ~sample, ~generation, ~run, ~substitution, ~count,
  "Ara3_5000", 5000, "SRR2589044", "A>G", 2,
  "Ara3_5000", 5000, "SRR2589044", "A>C", 0,
  "Ara3_5000", 5000, "SRR2589044", "A>T", 0,
  "Ara3_5000", 5000, "SRR2589044", "C>T", 2,
  "Ara3_5000", 5000, "SRR2589044", "C>G", 0,
  "Ara3_5000", 5000, "SRR2589044", "C>A", 2,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000, "SRR2584863", "A>G", 2,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000, "SRR2584863", "A>C", 8,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000, "SRR2584863", "A>T", 1,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000, "SRR2584863", "C>T", 3,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000, "SRR2584863", "C>G", 0,
  "Ara3_15000", 15000, "SRR2584863", "C>A", 6,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000, "SRR2584866", "A>G", 260,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000, "SRR2584866", "A>C", 13,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000, "SRR2584866", "A>T", 9,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000, "SRR2584866", "C>T", 370,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000, "SRR2584866", "C>G", 12,
  "Ara3_50000", 50000, "SRR2584866", "C>A", 24
)

datatable(substitution_spectrum, caption = "Collapsed substitution spectrum by sample")
```

```{r spectrum-plot, fig.width=9}
substitution_spectrum %>%
  mutate(sample = fct_reorder(sample, generation)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = substitution, y = count, fill = substitution)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ sample, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Collapsed single-nucleotide substitution spectrum",
       x = "Substitution class", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Functional annotation summary (from `impact_summary.tsv` / `consequence_summary.tsv`)

```{r impact-summary}
impact_summary <- tribble(
  ~generation, ~impact,     ~count,
  5000,        "HIGH",      2,
  5000,        "MODERATE",  6,
  5000,        "MODIFIER",  75,
  15000,       "HIGH",      3,
  15000,       "MODERATE",  17,
  15000,       "MODIFIER",  232,
  50000,       "HIGH",      72,
  50000,       "LOW",       213,
  50000,       "MODERATE",  374,
  50000,       "MODIFIER",  7367
)

datatable(impact_summary, caption = "SnpEff impact-category counts by generation")
```

```{r impact-plot}
impact_summary %>%
  mutate(impact = factor(impact, levels = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", "MODIFIER"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(generation), y = count, fill = impact)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "Relative proportion of SnpEff impact categories by generation",
       x = "Generation", y = "Proportion", fill = "Impact") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r consequence-summary}
consequence_summary <- tribble(
  ~generation, ~consequence,          ~count,
  5000,  "missense_variant",   6,
  5000,  "frameshift_variant", 2,
  5000,  "intergenic_region",  1,
  15000, "missense_variant",   16,
  15000, "frameshift_variant", 3,
  15000, "intergenic_region",  6,
  50000, "missense_variant",     369,
  50000, "synonymous_variant",   212,
  50000, "frameshift_variant",   62,
  50000, "stop_gained",          9,
  50000, "intergenic_region",    122
)

datatable(consequence_summary, caption = "Selected SnpEff consequence-type counts by generation (coding + intergenic classes)")
```

## Annotated gene table — high-impact and biologically flagged variants

```{r gene-table}
# Subset drawn from results/statistics/annotation/high_impact_variants.tsv,
# citrate_gene_variants.tsv, and dna_repair_variants.tsv
flagged_variants <- tribble(
  ~sample,       ~generation, ~gene,  ~consequence,        ~impact,    ~hgvs_p,
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "mutS", "stop_gained",        "HIGH",     "p.Gln606*",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "mutS", "missense_variant",   "MODERATE", "p.Arg500His",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "mutL", "missense_variant",   "MODERATE", "p.Ser567Gly",
  "Ara3_5000",   5000,        "dam",  "missense_variant",   "MODERATE", "p.Pro141Thr",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "citT", "missense_variant",   "MODERATE", "p.Thr341Ile",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "citF", "missense_variant",   "MODERATE", "p.Glu51Lys",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "citA", "frameshift_variant", "HIGH",     "p.Val493fs",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "lacZ", "stop_gained",        "HIGH",     "p.Trp433*",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "ddlB", "stop_gained",        "HIGH",     "p.Trp182*",
  "Ara3_50000",  50000,       "mutY", "frameshift_variant", "HIGH",     "p.Gly318fs"
)

datatable(flagged_variants,
          caption = "Selected high-impact and biologically flagged variants (mismatch-repair and citrate-operon genes)",
          options = list(pageLength = 10))
```
